Subject: SIG / CAIQ call request + key ask list

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. NovaGrid is running through our vendor SIG/CAIQ intake and we wanted to schedule a focused session to walk CAIQ answers and ask a few follow-ups around logging, retention, and network segmentation.

High-level asks for the call:
- Which CAIQ version you plan to use (we currently expect 2019 CAIQ baseline)
- Clarify data residency options for EU customer data and any region pinning
- Sample logs: access logs, audit logs (we'll need a redacted sample)
- Encryption in transit at load balancer and between services (TLS details)
- SOC 2: whether you have automated log archiving and typical retention windows

We're hoping for a 30–45 minute call next week. Our security team is available:
- Wed 10/21 10:00–12:00 PT
- Thu 10/22 14:00–16:00 PT

Please let me know what works and whether we should invite anyone else from your side. If you have a prep doc or mapping of owners for evidence items that would be super helpful.

Thanks,
Allison Park
Director, Information Security
NovaGrid

Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ call — availability and technical clarifications (Notes + next steps)

Allison / Tim —

Thanks for your time on Thursday. Recap and action items below (notes from the call):

Meeting summary:
- Walked the CAIQ mapping (2019 baseline) and identified ~12 questions requiring evidence samples or short clarifications.
- Covered logging patterns: we provided an anonymized sample log set and discussed redaction approach.
- Discussed encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; mutual TLS for private peering; KMS-managed keys at rest with customer-configurable KMS for Private deployments.
- Data residency: Hosted customers can pin region at provisioning; Dedicated/Private deployments support full EU-only hosting. Cross-region replication happens only for backup snapshots (opt-in) and is documented in our DR policy.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Upload redacted access + audit log samples (Marissa) — link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novagrid-shared — ETA: 2026-10-29
2) Share CAIQ answers spreadsheet (Rafael) — redwood-caiq-answers-2026.xlsx uploaded to Drive and attached to this thread — ETA: 2026-10-27 (done)
3) Provide short note on cross-region replication behavior and opt-in process (Irene) — ETA: 2026-10-30
4) Follow-up on SOC 2 retention windows and automated archiving (Grace) — include sample retention policy snippet — ETA: 2026-11-03

Attachments included in Drive and linked below. If you prefer we push the artifacts into your intake portal directly, let me know the upload link or HubSpot intake ID and we can do that.

Thanks again — happy to set a follow-up if your team needs a deeper dive on any item.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
